thread:
Laura (PM): Quick sync on Private Stack Connectivity sprint. Goal: ship a beta installer flow that minimizes customer networking work for VPC/on-prem.
Shiv (Eng): We should be explicit about supported egress topologies. I propose we enumerate 3 patterns and label experimental ones.
Maria (Field SE): From recent calls: customers mostly want to keep their NAT/GW and only allow outbound to Redwood control plane + optional metrics sinks. "Zero-touch" must work behind NAT.
Laura (PM): Draft support matrix: 1) NAT egress (supported), 2) Static egress IP (supported, with templates), 3) Relay/reverse-proxy (experimental). Call out IP-preserve caveats for migrations.
Anita (Customer Success): FinCorp requires an upgrade plan that preserves egress IPs and avoids cert churn. They will pilot if operator upgrade disruption <= 5m and rollback path exists.
Shiv (Eng): Implementation note: add an operator flag `safe_mode` that keeps old dataplane running until new control handshake completes. Pros: fast rollback. Cons: extra state and disk.
Tom (Release): Need automated canary gating: 10% installs on canary image, monitor health + trace latency for 30m, abort on >200ms tracer or >1% error. Can deploy-bot support this hook?
deploy-bot: Canary hook available. Command: `./scripts/canary-checks --duration=30m --latency-threshold=200` returns non-zero on failure.
Maria (Field SE): Add a troubleshooting checklist: how to verify NAT egress, small iptables fixes, and when to escalate to customer netops. These are common field asks.
Laura (PM): Proposed launch criteria for Beta:
- Beta release to 3 pilot customers (include FinCorp)
- Installer presets: `default` (NAT-friendly), `static-egress`, `relay` (experimental)
- Upgrade path validated with <=5m median disruption and documented rollback steps
- Network runbook + IP-preserve migration guide published
- Console canary gating + `safe_mode` operator enabled
If any missing -> ship as alpha instead.
Shiv (Eng): Estimate: 3 sprints for `safe_mode` + canary + presets, +1 sprint for docs & field validation. Can compress if we drop `relay` from MVP.
Anita (Customer Success): I'll prepare pilot communication and rollback SLA wording once we have static-egress docs.
Tom (Release): I will create canary pipeline slot and ensure image tagging `privdeploy-canary-<sha>`. Also add post-rollout quick checks for oncall.
Laura (PM): Action items:
- Shiv: implementation plan for `safe_mode` by EOD Tue
- Maria: sample network checklist for FinCorp by Wed
- Tom: canary pipeline slot by Thu
- Anita: pilot comms draft by Thu EOD
I'll make final launch decision.
Shiv (Eng): Ack. I'll also prototype a lightweight upgrade harness to measure actual downtime automatically.
Maria (Field SE): One more ask: include a short note about customer-managed KMS/HSM in installer docs; net teams ask about this alongside networking.
Laura (PM): Good call. I'll add KMS doc item to backlog. Marking for follow-up in next product huddle. :spiral_calendar:
